def collect(tool):
    # ruleid: lintro.python.none-coercion.capability-empty
    if not tool.can_scan:
        return []
    return tool.scan()


def supported(capability):
    # ruleid: lintro.python.none-coercion.capability-empty
    if not capability:
        return []
    return scan()


def explicit_unknown(tool):
    # ok: lintro.python.none-coercion.capability-empty
    if not tool.can_scan:
        return None


def fail_closed(tool):
    # ok: lintro.python.none-coercion.capability-empty
    if not tool.can_scan:
        raise RuntimeError("scan unavailable")


def not_a_capability(issues):
    # ok: lintro.python.none-coercion.capability-empty
    if not issues:
        return []
